inputs.notes: The exact .NET target framework and SDK, and the exact DevExpress package version — not a supported range. Read from the project file, the lock or restore output, and the toolchain on the machine that runs validation.

The DevExpress NuGet feed is a private feed that needs credentials. Which feed URL this project restores from, where the credential comes from, and whether CI has it. A restore that works on one machine is not evidence that the feed is configured.
Which documentation source is authoritative for DevExpress and which for plain ASP.NET Core, and which must not be consulted for either. Recorded in mcp/source-routing.md.
What counts as one feature in this codebase, and what a feature may touch — including whether a report definition is part of a feature or a separate artefact with its own lifecycle.

The exact build, test and lint commands, and what their failure looks like. A command nobody has run is not a validation profile, and a build that only restores from a warm package cache has not proved the feed works.
Whether this stack's material may appear in a public repository. Report definitions and connection strings are the usual leak; a licence key is the other.
